programmes.d: In 1991, the bodies of sex workers started being discovered in Detroit, Michigan.
After two couples were brutally murdered three years apart, both cases went cold for almost three decades.
In September 2007, 50-year-old Vietnamese immigrant Cuc Tran was raped and murdered while out on a run.
In 1992, Leslie Allen Williams was arrested after a witness saw him assaulting and abducting a woman.
On Mother's Day in 2008, Edward Covington unleashed a horrifying attack on his girlfriend and her children.
Convicted sex offender James Randall was responsible for the murders of two women in Florida in the mid-1990s.
When 9-year-old Felecia Williams was reported to have run away, the police were immediately suspicious.
In 1995, mother and daughter Marcia and Elizabeth Honsch went missing.
In 2012, Diane Staudte murdered her husband and son in addition to attempting to kill one of her daughters.
One strange day in a quintessential small southern town, Alvin Ridley reported the death of his wife in the early hours of the morning.
A 21-year-old California man is suspected of hiring a hitman to kill his parents and sister in order to gain financial control of the family's estate.

A look at the case of Debra Jean Milke, on death row in Arizona for arranging the murder of her 4-year-old son. Prosecutors say Milke had the little boy killed because she considered him an "inconvenience".
The incredible story of Bob Lowe, an innocent bystander who witnessed a mob murder, then agreed to enter the witness protection program as he waited to testify at the trial.

Tim Boczkowski, a well-liked member of a community near Pittsburgh, is accused of murdering his first wife in a bathtub and his second wife in a hot tub. Includes interviews with Tim's children Randy, Sandy, and Todd.
A local bad boy in a California town, once a suspect in the disappearance of a young woman, is suspected of a similar crime 13 years later.
A new series that tells the real-life stories of people who faced life-threatening events, yet somehow found the courage and strength to survive against all odds.
Brandi and her friend, Liz, offer a ride to a man who turns on them, stabbing Liz repeatedly and beating Brandi, and then throwing her into a river.
A man hires a killer to bump off his wife, but instead, he kills another woman with the exact same name.
A young German grifter moves to America, adopts various identities and kills many people along the way.
A young teen disappears from a small American town. Then several years later, he turns up, in Europe. But is it really him? And if not, what happened to the young teen?
A man is murdered by his cheating wife's lover, who had been living in their closet.
A dead body discovered outside of a church leads to a world of sex, drugs, and Halloween pranks.
A Washington man hires a sleazy amateur hitman to kill his wife. And when she turns the tables on her attacker, the gaping holes in their master plan are revealed.

A murdered Nebraska woman is connected to three men with hidden agendas—her best friend, her neighbor, and her ex-boyfriend. And a high-tech whodunit investigation ultimately reveals the killer left behind a smoking 'bun'.

After a whirlwind romance, a 40-something San Francisco woman finds herself married to the man of her dreams. Only she soon finds herself hospitalized with a mysterious illness, and her fairytale becomes a bizarre murder mystery instead.

An aspiring cannibal finds an online buddy who fantasizes about being eaten. And when the two men arrange a dinner where the guest of honor is also the main course, the macabre soiree turns into a horrifying bloodbath.

A woman is bludgeoned to death in her own home, and her severely handicapped teenage daughter goes missing. When investigators eventually catch up with the young woman, they hear a baffling story of a mother's toxic love.

Celebrity little people and twin wrestlers Jorge and Miguel have a larger-than-life appetite for drugs and alcohol. And when they're both found dead after a wild night of partying, an autopsy reveals the culprit is eye drops.
A high-rolling, high-priced fortune-teller is slaughtered, and detectives must decipher a bizarre set of clues that weave superstition and brutality in equal measure.
A wannabe serial killer ropes in his first unsuspecting victim. But it turns out that killing in real life is trickier than it looks on TV.

When a man's fiancée is brutally stabbed to death, he finds solace in the arms of a sympathetic ex-lover. But when she is later arrested for attempting to murder her own husband, a shocking web of love, obsession, and deceit begins to unravel.
Faced with mounting debts and his upcoming honeymoon, a delusional bloodthirsty actor casts himself in a role that includes murder and dismemberment.
An anti-drug crusader's home is torched. But when a body is discovered in the freezer, the curious case of arson becomes a twisted tale of fratricide.
When a couple disappears from a Georgia beach town, detectives interrogate a pair of gun-toting cat burglars with dueling cover stories, some sordid souvenirs, and a telltale scrapbook.
When she's caught stealing, an aspiring 20-something lifestyle blogger tries to prevent herself from being fired and gets locked up for murder instead.
A manhunt ensues after a homemade bomb explodes in New York's Chelsea neighbourhood, injuring 30 people.
A serial killer stalking Yosemite National Park is caught by an FBI profiler who reveals the murderer's darkest inner secrets.
The FBI launches an international investigation to track down the armed attackers who stormed the U.S. Special Mission in Benghazi, Libya, killing the US Ambassador and three other Americans.
